signals.entity: Banca Naţională a României (National Bank of Romania, BNR)

WINNER: Digital Professional Services SRL, fiscal code RO43040394, Bucharest. Contract 44/P/2026 dated 18/05/2026; published value RON 335,000. First time BNR's HSM support incumbent is named in this pipeline.
signals.source_name: SICAP/SEAP award notice SCNA1133162 (caNoticeId 100620422)
signals.implies: Head-on with Printec line 9 (payment security, HSM/key management — Thales payShield, PCI-PIN, remote key injection). A small Romanian integrator holds the central bank's HSM support; Printec's route is displacement at renewal plus selling the same capability into BCR/BRD/CEC/BT.
signals.likelihood: Renewal cycle 12-24 months; near-term is competitive positioning, not an open bid
signals.followup: Check ONRC filing and Thales/Utimaco partner status of Digital Professional Services SRL (RO43040394); size the BNR HSM estate ahead of the ~Q2-2027 successor notice.

signals.entity: Banca Naţională a României (BNR)

signals.implies: Printec lines 8 (physical ATM/branch security) and 11 (managed/field services). Treat as channel partner, not target.
signals.followup: Evaluate RASIROM as a Romanian delivery partner for anti-skimming / IBNS rather than a competitor to displace.

signals.entity: Direcţia Generală Regională a Finanţelor Publice Craiova
signals.signal: AWARDS — CASH-COUNTING MACHINE SERVICE, DIRECT FIT: two SICAP award notices, SCNA1133486 (28/05/2026) and SCNA1135126 (20/07/2026), both for 'Servicii de Mentenanță, de întreținere și/sau reparații, pentru masini de numarat/legat bancnote si numarat monede' (maintenance/repair of banknote counting-and-strapping and coin-counting machines). WINNER in both: CA.DA GRUPP SRL, fiscal code 45744884. SCNA1133486 covers 5 contracts totalling RON 449,628 (latest 22/05/2026); SCNA1135126 covers 3 contracts totalling RON 199,600 (latest 17/07/2026). The underlying open procedure SCN1176462 (est. signals.likelihood: Rolls over roughly every 6-12 months; next window ~Q1 2027
signals.followup: Profile CA.DA GRUPP SRL (45744884) — brands serviced, engineer count; build a multi-DGRFP national service proposition rather than bidding region by region.

signals.entity: Direcţia Generală Regională a Finanţelor Publice Cluj-Napoca
signals.signal: AWARDS — SUSTAINED CASH-MACHINE SERVICE STREAM: 14 direct-acquisition awards published 04/08/2026-25/08/2026, all to EUTRON INVEST ROMANIA SRL, fiscal code RO 4096491, totalling RON 25,463.94. Each covers repair, fault assessment or servicing of RIBAO BCS 160 banknote-counting machines at named Treasury offices (Cluj-Napoca, Turda, Huedin, Salonta, Marghita, Aleșd, Baia Mare, Sighetu Marmației, Vișeu de Sus, Satu Mare, Bistrița Năsăud, Sângeorz Băi, Șinleu Silvaniei). Largest single: DAN2832998, 17/08/2026, RON 5,852.45. A separate award, DAN2753453 (12/05/2026), gave Municipiul Bacău's counting-machine maintenance to OFFICE HQ SRL, RO32152007, RON 24,297.78.
signals.source_name: SICAP direct-acquisition award notices DAN2823746/DAN2823769/DAN2824187-DAN2839421 series; DAN2753453
signals.implies: Printec line 1 (banknote counting/sorting) and line 11 (field maintenance). Reveals the real Romanian Treasury cash-machine estate: low-cost Chinese RIBAO BCS 160 counters serviced piecemeal by micro-vendors at a few hundred lei per call. That fragmentation is the opening — a single national managed-service framework (Printec's model) beats 14 separate direct awards.
signals.likelihood: Continuous; new direct awards appear weekly
signals.followup: Pitch ANAF/DGRFP centrally on a national counting-machine managed-service framework plus a fleet upgrade to Glory/Sesami; name EUTRON INVEST (RO 4096491) and OFFICE HQ (RO32152007) as incumbents.

signals.entity: C.N. Poşta Română S.A. (Romanian Post)

signals.source_name: SICAP contract notice CN1095543
signals.implies: Printec's cash-in-transit adjacency and line 1 (cash automation). signals.followup: Not a Printec bid (pure CIT), but use it to size Poșta Română's cash volumes and pitch counting/recycling automation plus off-site ATMs into the post-office network.

signals.entity: CEC Bank S.A. (state-owned commercial bank) — as public-sector acquirer
signals.signal: CEC Bank (RO361897) is the single most-awarded card-acquiring provider on SICAP this quarter, named winner in at least eight separate award notices: CAN1145748 DGRFP Bucharest (27/05/2026, 8 contracts, RON 2,926,882.55); CAN1162613 Oficiul Naţional al Registrului Comerţului EFT-POS (12/06/2026, 5 contracts, RON 2,289,600.48); CAN1151682 DGRFP (10/06/2026, 8 contracts, RON 2,055,793.87); CAN1167371 DGRFP (03/07/2026, 4 contracts, RON 2,302,498.40); SCNA1134431 DGITL Sector 1 (01/07/2026, RON 1,151,778.33); SCNA1129839 Municipiul Bacău SNEP (14/07/2026, 6 contracts, RON 1,014,500); CAN1172870 DGRFP treasury-cashier framework (14/08/2026, RON 4,457,700); CAN1156763 Poşta Română TEZAUR online card processing (07/08/2026, RON 10,756,800); and CAN1173223 Loteria Română electronic transaction processing (24/08/2026, RON 3,755,529.65).
signals.implies: Printec line 3 (POS/acquiring/TMS) and line 12 (digital channels). CEC Bank is winning Romanian public-sector acquiring wholesale and therefore must be deploying and managing a rapidly growing POS/self-service estate. It is the single highest-value Romanian acquiring prospect for terminal supply, terminal management (x-pos/POSight/TMS), softPOS and key injection.
signals.likelihood: Estate expansion is happening now; sales cycle 6-12 months
signals.followup: Direct approach to CEC Bank cards/acquiring on terminal supply + TMS + remote key injection, evidencing the nine public-sector wins above as estate growth.

signals.entity: CEC Bank S.A. — own procurement channel
signals.signal: NEGATIVE/ACCESS FINDING: CEC Bank's public procurement page cec.ro/achizitii (reachable with a desktop Chrome User-Agent; blocked to a default agent) lists exactly ONE procedure across all pages — 'Procedura de achiziție prin licitație organizată în vederea achizitiei solutiei IT de servicii de mesagerie tip Info SMS' (IT SMS-messaging solution), posted 25/02/2026, offers to the Central Registry at Calea Victoriei 13, deadline 13.03.2026 14:00 — long past. Page 1 returns 'Nu sunt rezultate'. Separately, CEC Bank does NOT appear as a contracting authority in the SICAP contract-notice or award feeds for 01/05/2026-27/08/2026, nor do Eximbank, Banca Transilvania, BRD or BCR. [STANDING — pattern dated 2026]
signals.source_name: cec.ro/achizitii (retrieved with desktop UA); SICAP api-pub buyer sweep over 8,279 contract notices and 16,634 award notices
signals.implies: Confirms the structural point for Romania: commercial-bank ATM, self-service and POS buying is NOT visible on SEAP/SICAP because those banks are not contracting authorities under Law 98/2016 for their own commercial activity. Even state-owned CEC Bank publishes almost nothing. Printec cannot pipeline Romanian bank hardware from this portal — it must be direct sales, with SICAP used only to read state-sector demand and competitor identities.
signals.followup: Do not scope Romanian bank ATM/POS demand from SICAP. Track BCR/BRD/BT/Raiffeisen/ING via IR reports, ARB/BNR statistics and direct contact instead; keep cec.ro/achizitii on a monthly desktop-UA poll.

signals.entity: SelfPay (Netopia/SelfPay, RO26067497) + Salt Bank (RO10318789)
signals.signal: COMPETITOR WINS — UNATTENDED SELF-SERVICE PAYMENT TERMINALS: the SelfPay/Salt Bank pairing won at least three Romanian local-tax buyers this quarter. CAN1161203 DGITL Sector 1 Bucharest (03/07/2026) 'Servicii de colectare plăți prin intermediul terminalelor de plată neasistate, precum și servicii de închiriere terminale de plată neasistate' (payment collection via unattended payment terminals plus terminal rental), 7 contracts, RON 6,110,317.82, latest 29/05/2026. SCNA1133771 Direcţia Fiscală Timişoara (08/06/2026), 2 contracts, RON 1,144,328, latest 02/06/2026. CAN1166131 Direcţia Fiscală Braşov (30/06/2026), 4 contracts, RON 352,317.50 alongside Banca Transilvania on other lots. Also DAN2782089 (17/06/2026), Direcţia Fiscală Locală Târgu Mureș rented a SelfPay self-service terminal for RON 8,204.
signals.source_name: SICAP award notices CAN1161203, SCNA1133771, CAN1166131; direct-acquisition award DAN2782089
signals.implies: Direct competition with Printec line 2 (self-service kiosks) and line 3 (unattended acceptance). SelfPay operates the terminal estate as a service and bundles the acquiring through Salt Bank — an operating model Printec can match through Printec Cash Network (the Greek Cashflex/KEA vehicle already runs ~850 off-site ATMs as a service).
signals.followup: Assess a Romanian terminal-as-a-service vehicle mirroring Printec Cash Network; target the local-tax buyers SelfPay has not yet taken (Municipiul Arad CN1095003 below).

signals.signal: OPEN TENDER — SELF-SERVICE STATIONS: CN1095003 'Acord-cadru de servicii de incasari impozite, taxe si alte venituri bugetare locale prin statii de tip self-service' (framework for collecting local taxes and other budget revenue through self-service stations), CPV 66110000, estimated RON 1,536,964, published 03/08/2026, bids due 10/09/2026 15:00. signals.source_name: SICAP contract notices CN1095003, CN1094319, SCN1175047
signals.implies: Printec line 2 (self-service kiosks and branch transformation, x-visio) plus line 3. Romanian municipalities are systematically outsourcing counter cash/card collection to self-service estates — a repeatable, tenderable segment where Printec's kiosk + cash-recycling combination is stronger than SelfPay's card-only terminals.
signals.followup: Bid or partner on CN1095003 before 10/09/2026; build a reusable Romanian municipal self-service reference from it.

signals.signal: COMPETITOR WINS — CARD ACCEPTANCE: CAN1167036 and CAN1167026, Municipiul Cluj-Napoca (both 05/05/2026), e-commerce/SNEP card acceptance RON 445,000 and assisted-POS card acceptance RON 310,000, contract 443192/444151 of 02/04/2026. signals.entity: Banca Comercială Română (BCR, 361757) and Garanti Bank (25394008)
signals.signal: COMPETITOR WINS — PUBLIC-SECTOR BANKING/ACQUIRING: BCR won CAN1168584 Ministerul Dezvoltării (28/05/2026) banking-fee services RON 350,000; CAN1171655 DGRFP Craiova (30/07/2026) financial-banking services for the Caracal and other Treasury units, 6 contracts, RON 825,654; CAN1131180 DGRFP (10/08/2026), 10 contracts, RON 743,804; plus recurring monthly POS acquiring direct awards to Jandarmeria Română (DAN2808333/DAN2808335/DAN2808344, 14/07/2026) and Ministerul Justiţiei (DAN2746843, 04/05/2026, RON 33,333.28). signals.implies: Printec line 3 and line 12. BCR is a named Printec APTRA reference already; these wins confirm BCR and Garanti are expanding public-sector card acceptance and therefore terminal estate. Reinforces that the Romanian opportunity is bank-side, not tender-side.

signals.entity: Romanian e-signature / digital-identity market (CERTSIGN, DIGISIGN, Centrul de Calcul, Insight Group)
signals.signal: HIGH-FREQUENCY DIRECT AWARDS: the SICAP direct-acquisition feed for 01/05/2026-27/08/2026 returns 151 hits for 'semnătură electronică' (electronic signature). Repeat named winners across public buyers include CERTSIGN S.A. (RO18288250 — e.g. DAN2747217, DAN2747507, DAN2749108, DAN2750720), DIGISIGN S.A. (RO 17544945, DAN2748797), Centrul de Calcul S.A. (RO 2163993, DAN2745702 CNAIR qualified-signature kit RON 7,000; DAN2745851), Insight Group (RO 16674319) and GO SERV (RO 6919950). Individual values are tiny (RON 95-7,000 per certificate/kit).
signals.source_name: SICAP direct-acquisition award feed, contractObject='semnatura electronica' (151 results)
signals.implies: Printec line 5 (digital identity, onboarding, e-signature — Namirial, eIDAS/EUDI). Romania has an entrenched domestic qualified-trust-service duopoly (CertSign, DigiSign) selling at commodity prices to the public sector. Printec's differentiation is not certificates but the eIDAS/EUDI-wallet onboarding and remote-signing workflow sold into banks, where CertSign/DigiSign are the incumbents to partner with or displace.
signals.likelihood: Continuous; EUDI Wallet deadlines drive a step change through 2026-2027
signals.followup: Position Namirial-based remote onboarding/e-signature at Romanian banks, treating CertSign/DigiSign as the certificate layer; do not chase public-sector certificate direct awards.

signals.entity: SEAP/SICAP portal (e-licitatie.ro) — coverage verdict for cash automation
signals.signal: NEGATIVE FINDING, DELIBERATELY SEARCHED: across 8,279 contract notices and 16,634 award notices published 01/05/2026-27/08/2026, plus 802 direct-acquisition awards retrieved by 41 Romanian and English keywords, SEAP/SICAP contains NO tender or award for an ATM, cash recycler, intelligent-deposit machine, banknote sorter or teller cash recycler. Every cash-equipment record found is either maintenance of low-cost RIBAO BCS 160 counters at State Treasury offices (CA.DA GRUPP, EUTRON INVEST, OFFICE HQ) or consumables (cash bags at BNR and Poşta Română). A CPV sweep of 30123600/30123620/30123630/30132xxx/42961xxx returned only parcel sorting, e-ticketing and access control. Searched terms included bancomat, ATM, mașină de numărat bancnote, numărare numerar, recycler, depunere numerar, sortare bancnote, terminale POS, ghișeu automat, chioșc/kiosk, self-service, HSM, criptograf, personalizare card.
signals.source_name: SICAP api-pub NoticeCommon/GetCNoticeList + GetCANoticeList + DaAwardNoticeCommon/GetDaAwardNoticeList, full 01/05/2026-27/08/2026 window
signals.implies: Confirms and sharpens the structural verdict for Romania: ATM/recycler demand sits entirely with private commercial banks that are not contracting authorities, so it is invisible to this portal. Printec should treat SEAP/SICAP as a competitor-identification and state-sector (Treasury, BNR, Poşta Română, municipalities) channel only, and pipeline Romanian bank hardware exclusively through direct sales.
signals.likelihood: Structural; unchanged for the foreseeable future
signals.followup: Reduce SICAP effort to a monthly delta scan on the four proven endpoints; reallocate Romanian research effort to BNR/ARB statistics, bank IR reports and direct bank contact.

coverage_notes: PORTAL: Romania SEAP/SICAP (www.e-licitatie.ro). METHOD: cracked the api-pub JSON layer rather than the SPA. Confirmed the documented 403 guard (Referer + Origin + desktop Chrome UA required) and confirmed the documented filter breakage — contractObject/contractTitle and caNameFN are silently ignored on GetCANoticeList/GetCNoticeList, which cap at 3,000 rows sorted OLDEST-FIRST, so an unfiltered pull returns only 2019-2020 data. NEW ROUTE FOUND THIS RUN (worth recording for future runs): the undocumented parameters startPublicationDate and endPublicationDate DO work on both list endpoints, so the cap is defeated by pulling weekly windows. Pulled 01/05/2026-27/08/2026 in 17 weekly windows: 8,279 unique contract notices (GetCNoticeList) and 16,634 unique award notices (GetCANoticeList), then filtered LOCALLY on 40+ RO/EN keywords and on 35 CPV prefixes. SECOND NEW ROUTE: award notices carry no winner in the list payload; winners were obtained by reverse-engineering the lazily-loaded SPA module at https://www.e-licitatie.ro/js/pub/notices/ca-notice/service, which revealed four per-procedure-type controllers — C_PUBLIC_CANotice, PC_PUBLIC_CANotice, DC_PUBLIC_CANotice, RFQ_PUBLIC_CANotice — each exposing POST /api-pub/{ctrl}/GetCANoticeContracts/ with the full filter object (caNoticeId, contractNo, winnerTitle, winnerFiscalNumber, contractDate/contractValue/contractMinOffer/contractMaxOffer from-to objects, contractTitle, lots, sortOrder, sysContractFrameworkType, skip, take). This returns winner name, fiscal/registration number, full address, contract number, contract date and value — 56 award notices were resolved to named winners this way. THIRD NEW ROUTE: POST /api-pub/DaAwardNoticeCommon/GetDaAwardNoticeList/ (below-threshold direct acquisitions) DOES honour a contractObject keyword filter plus publicationDateStart; 41 keyword queries returned 802 unique direct awards with supplier names and values, which is where the small cash-machine and kiosk winners live. ALSO COVERED: the TED tier-0 cache (56 Romanian notices in the 13/07-27/08/2026 window) was read and cross-checked; cec.ro/achizitii was retrieved successfully with a desktop Chrome UA (single stale item, all pages); bcr.ro and brd.ro procurement pages were checked; two open-web searches in Romanian on ATM/self-service tenders and on RoPay/instant payments were run and produced only market-context press, no primary tender. PRODUCT-LINE SWEEP (rule 10) — what this portal showed and did NOT show this run. FOUND: (1) cash automation — only counting-machine SERVICE (CA.DA GRUPP, EUTRON INVEST, OFFICE HQ) and cash bags, no machines; (2) self-service kiosks — yes (ANDAN IMPEX, SelfPay, INFOCHIOȘC, Arad/Oneşti self-service stations); (3) POS/acquiring/TMS — yes, heavily (CEC Bank, Banca Transilvania, BCR, Garanti, BRD, SelfPay/Salt Bank, ROPECO for POS maintenance); (4) payments modernization — yes at BNR (Wall Street Systems/ION, Montran); (5) digital identity/e-signature — yes, high volume, low value (CertSign, DigiSign, Centrul de Calcul); (7) compliance/document management — partly (BNR document-management solution, STAR STORAGE SA, RON 3,951,792, CAN1098854); (8) physical ATM/branch security — yes (RASIROM, BNR CN1093831, Poşta Română CN1092504, ANCOM); (9) HSM/key management — yes (BNR/Digital Professional Services; DEER PKI-HSM cancelled); (11) managed/field services — yes, fragmented. SHOWED NOTHING AT ALL THIS RUN: (6) fraud and transaction monitoring — zero notices, no INETCO/FICO-shaped requirement anywhere in either feed; (10) card issuing and personalisation — zero ('personalizare card' returned 0 direct awards, and the only 'emitere card' hits are football-club player cards and meal-voucher reissues); (12) core banking and digital channels — zero, no core-banking or digital-channel procurement by any Romanian entity in the window. CARRIED BASELINE ITEMS STATUSED: BNR CN1093831 (TED 499473-2026) = closed 06/08/2026, award pending, still 'In desfasurare'. DGRFP Craiova CN1094258 = closed 13/08/2026, award pending. ANCOM CN1094796 = still OPEN, closes 31/08/2026. Nuclearelectrica security systems could not be separately isolated in the window beyond CAN1172162 (DCS control-system replacement, RON 3,865,512, no cash/security-equipment content) — status unverified this run. GENUINE GAPS: no award notice has yet been published for BNR CN1093831, DGRFP Craiova CN1094258, CNAIR CN1093434, CFR Călători CN1093496, Poşta Română SCN1176522 or CN1092504 — all six are genuinely pending on the portal, not missed. Confidence is capped at Medium per the single-agent rule.
access_issues: 1) https://www.e-licitatie.ro/api-pub/... — GET returns {"message":"The requested resource does not support http method 'GET'"}; all list endpoints are POST. With Referer + Origin + desktop Chrome UA there was NO 403 at any point this run (the documented 'Referrer cannot be null' guard was satisfied). 2) Unfiltered GetCNoticeList/GetCANoticeList silently cap at total=3000 sorted ASCENDING from 2013, i.e. an unfiltered pull returns only 2019-2020 rows and would have produced a false 'nothing found'. Worked around with weekly startPublicationDate/endPublicationDate windows (17 windows per endpoint). 3) Sorting parameters (sortColumn, sortDirection, sortColumnsList) are accepted and IGNORED; publicationDateStart/publicationDateFrom/noticeStateDateStart/pubDateStart are accepted and IGNORED on the two notice-list endpoints — only startPublicationDate/endPublicationDate work there, while the direct-acquisition endpoint uses publicationDateStart instead. Documented here so the next run does not re-derive it. 4) The notice DETAIL endpoints are not discoverable from the main bundles: /api-pub/{PublicNotice,NoticeCommon,CANotice,PublicCANotice,CANoticeCommon,ENotice}/GetCANotice all return 'No HTTP resource was found'. Resolved by fetching the lazily-loaded Angular module at https://www.e-licitatie.ro/js/pub/notices/ca-notice/service (note the /js prefix and NO .js suffix — /pub/... returns the SPA shell and /pub/....js returns a 500 redirect to /assets/errors/internal-error.htm), which named the four *_PUBLIC_CANotice controllers. 5) GetCANoticeContracts returns ["Eroare de sistem ...","Value cannot be null. Parameter name: collection"] unless the FULL filter object is sent including sortOrder:[] and the four from/to range objects. 6) https://www.cec.ro/achizitii — as documented, needs a desktop Chrome User-Agent; retrieved successfully, content is Drupal-rendered and required local HTML-to-text extraction. Content is genuinely a single stale item, not a fetch failure. 7) No CAPTCHA was encountered and no login wall was bypassed. No source was dropped silently.
